lines.text: Meta just joined the frontier AI race.
On October 12, Meta Superintelligence Labs released a new model family called Muse Wonder.
Here are three things to know.
Number 3. It's two models: Muse Wonder, and the bigger Muse Wonder Full, which Meta calls its most capable model yet.
Number 2. It's built for AI agents that get things done, on personal and professional tasks.
Number 1. It isn't free. In the Muse app it needs a paid plan, $20 or $100 a month. Wonder Full is only for Muse Code subscribers.
Meta says it's on par with ChatGPT and Claude at coding.
But outside testers haven't confirmed that yet. Would you pay for it?
